notes: Inflow used directly from the dataset (Inflow (Cusecs) column) -- not derived via water balance.
Storage represented via Gross Capacity (TMC), the most complete storage-related column.
Training window restricted to dates where catchment rainfall data exists (~1994-2019); reservoir data outside this window (1990-93, 2020-2026) exists but has no rainfall to feature-engineer from.

Both raw-scale and log-scale RMSE reported because inflow is heavily right-skewed (mostly low flow, with monsoon flood spikes exceeding 1 lakh cusecs per the KRS O&M manual) -- raw RMSE is dominated by a small number of extreme flood days.
